description: Subscription directory and hiring board for the UAE's Tier 2/3 aerospace and MRO supply chain.
tagline: Connecting primes with UAE subcontractors and ICV-registered vendors.

authors.name: Aerospace UAE Editorial Team
authors.bio: Curating the directory and reference data for the UAE's aerospace and MRO supply chain.

editorial.testing: All supplier listings and ICV registrations are verified against provided company documentation prior to inclusion in the directory.
editorial.monetization: We operate through paid supplier listings, recruiter job postings, and a premium subcontractor-matching newsletter.
editorial.corrections: Factual errors in directory listings or reference data are corrected within 24 hours of being reported and verified. Contact us to submit a correction.
